design_principle: Keep A fixed on the left and B fixed on the right; guide attention through their desks, PCs, faces, and status UI without flipping or rebuilding the source images.

cuts.focal_subject_left: A reacting to the incoming email beside the left PC
cuts.focal_subject_right: B reacting to the same email beside the right PC
cuts.dominant_action: A shared notification lands, then attention converges on the PCs
cuts.continuity_target: Match the center desk/PC zone into the 10:30 workflow state while preserving A-left and B-right
cuts.camera_motion: slow push-in toward the shared PC line, ending slightly low and centered

cuts.focal_subject_left: A manually working through accumulating red tasks
cuts.focal_subject_right: B monitoring BridgePatch completion on the green UI
cuts.dominant_action: Attention travels from A's growing queue to B's completed processing state
cuts.continuity_target: Carry the left/right work contrast and desk line into the matched lunch contrast
cuts.camera_motion: lateral pan from the left task stack to the right completion card

audio_cue.type: soft time tick plus confirmation at 3.72

cuts.focal_subject_left: A eating while still working at the left desk
cuts.focal_subject_right: B calmly enjoying lunch at the right desk
cuts.dominant_action: The two lunch reactions appear on the same visual beat for a quiet contrast
cuts.continuity_target: Hold both subjects at equal scale, then reveal the afternoon through the desk split
cuts.camera_motion: subtle parallax with equal and opposite drift around the center divider

cuts.focal_subject_left: A visibly fatigued with remaining red tasks
cuts.focal_subject_right: B with room for mentoring, coffee, and calm review
cuts.dominant_action: Focus shifts from A's fatigue to B's available attention and completed work
cuts.continuity_target: Land on B's right-side final-check area while A remains visible on the left
cuts.camera_motion: focus shift simulated by alternating left/right overlay emphasis and a restrained rightward push

cuts.focal_subject_left: A finishing exhausted, then looking toward B
cuts.focal_subject_right: B calmly performing the final human check
cuts.dominant_action: Push into B's final check, leave a short beat, then reveal A's punchline
cuts.continuity_target: Resolve green approval into the BridgePatch green brand accent on the end card
cuts.camera_motion: slow right-biased push-in followed by a clean editorial release
